question: Does replacing total by rest score change operational latent-null Holm-FWER for the same ordinal-LR procedure? No assumption that rest score fixes the latent/observed conditioning mismatch.
methods: production ordinal LR omnibus, total score
same production ordinal LR omnibus, rest score excluding studied item
dgp: Existing gen_ordinal, N500/500 J10 C4 a=linspace(.9,1.8), b=linspace(-1,1)+[-1,0,1], normal theta mean0/-0.5 SD1, no true latent DIF, local independence
matching: Total uses all ten items including target; rest uses the other nine. No purification or selected anchors; exact same raw matrix and row order for both methods.
multiplicity: Holm across the same two items primary; BH descriptive secondary
primary: Mean paired dataset-level Holm event difference D=I_total-I_rest
estimand_note: False-DIF operating risk relative to latent invariance, not the same formal conditional null for the two matching variables
n_derivation: D in [-1,1] implies Var(D)<=1, so true MCSE(mean D)<=1/sqrt(R). R=ceil(1/.02^2)=2500. This is not a .02 confidence-halfwidth target.
primary_ci: Fixed-R marginal two-sided distribution-free Hoeffding: mean D +/- sqrt(2 log(2/.05)/R), clipped to [-1,1]
secondary_fwer_intervals: Per-method exact CP at 97.5% (Bonferroni joint >=95% for two methods). These do not guarantee the older PR118 .02 interval-deviation target.
acceptance: For paired direction, primary interval must exclude0, after full fixed R and prespecified validity checks. Method-specific scoped control requires upper bound<=.05, inflation lower>.05; otherwise INCONCLUSIVE. No general method certification or production-label change.
failures: Retain all data/results. Any incomplete item family invalid. Report valid-case paired statistics and missing-pair sensitivity; no failed test imputed as no rejection. Confirmatory precision claim only with complete valid fixed R; otherwise diagnostic/inconclusive.
seed_rule: 2026110100 + replication_index, same raw data for both methods; no outcome-dependent seed replacement
timing_rule: Pilot included in fixed2500 only if all tests valid and no method/settings change. Stop if projected total exceeds1800s. No threshold/precision adjustment after outcomes.
timing_limitation: Rest timing not yet measured; estimate is not guaranteed; 30-pair feasibility stage required. No optional stopping for significant/favorable results. Budget/validity stop => no confirmatory acceptance.
scope_limits: Only this DGP/impact/test length/family/no-selection setting; no power, anchor-selection or general FDR claims
